BiblicalUsage: lēmpsis means receiving, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Philippians 4:15, "no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe giving and receiving belong together — the Philippians were the one church that shared with Paul in giving and receiving, and God counts both.
